value.body: A two-year master's in human nutrition. Programmes go by names such as Food & Nutrition, Clinical Nutrition, Dietetics or Food Science & Nutrition, and cover advanced nutrition, clinical and therapeutic diets, community and public-health nutrition, food science and research methods, often with a hospital or field internship. It is a common route to clinical dietitian, nutrition research and programme roles.

items.label: Course length
items.note: Some universities offer a one-year PG diploma in dietetics as an alternative

items.label: PG students in Nutrition

items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 13 PG enrolment by discipline, actual responses (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's in nutrition, dietetics, home science, food science or a related life science (rules vary by university). Admission is through CUET-PG at participating universities, a university entrance test, or graduation merit.

value.title: At a glance
items: Programme names vary, so the syllabus and internship matter more than the title.
A PG qualification plus a supervised internship is part of the route to the Indian Dietetic Association's Registered Dietitian exam (as reported).
